name: sq
meaning: squares of vel's components (0x48b448..0x48b497); x and z give the speed by sqrt

name: vel
meaning: velocity (0,-200,0) plus the water current; Wolf_WaterFloatUpStep's view of g_collScratchA 0x6d5468 (0x48b3c5)

name: flow
meaning: water current (0x48b3e3 add eax,0x1c into Zone_GetFlowVelocity)

name: step
meaning: this frame's displacement (0x48b512 add eax,0x24 into Vec3s_ScaleByDt)
